gloss: efficiently; deftly; in a well-organized manner

definitions.gloss: efficiently; deftly; in a well-organized manner
definitions.explanation: Doing something in a smart, organized way that gets good results without wasting time or effort.

examples.japanese: {要領|ようりょう}よく{仕事|しごと}を{片付|かたづ}けた。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{要領|ようりょう}よく{説明|せつめい}するので{分|わ}かりやすい。
examples.english: She explains things in a well-organized way, so it's easy to understand.

examples.japanese: {限|かぎ}られた{時間|じかん}の{中|なか}で{要領|ようりょう}よく{準備|じゅんび}を{進|すす}めないと、{本番|ほんばん}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない。
examples.english: If we don't prepare efficiently within the limited time, we won't make it in time for the real thing.

notes:
Formed from {要領|ようりょう} (the knack; the key point) + よく (well). Describes someone who grasps the essentials quickly and acts on them without wasted motion. Can carry a slightly envious or even mildly negative connotation — implying someone is shrewd or cuts corners skillfully.

The opposite is {要領|ようりょう}が{悪|わる}い (to be bad at getting things done efficiently; clumsy in approach).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {要領|ようりょう}よくこなす: to handle efficiently
- {要領|ようりょう}よくまとめる: to summarize concisely
- {要領|ようりょう}よく{立|た}ち{回|まわ}る: to maneuver deftly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手際|てぎわ}よく: skillfully; deftly — emphasizes smooth execution of a task
- {効率|こうりつ}よく: efficiently — more neutral and objective
- {器用|きよう}に: skillfully; adroitly — emphasizes inherent dexterity
